get_models: fetch the list of supported models from the OCP API using the Client class
get_bulks: fetch the list of supported bulk materials from the OCP API using the Client class
get_adsorbates: fetch the list of supported adsorbates from the OCP API using the Client class
get_slabs: get a unique list of slabs for a given bulk structure via the OCP API Client
submit_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: submit adsorbate configurations for relaxation on a slab using a specified model via the OCP API Client
